editor: visual
---

```{r}
overall_grade <- function() {
  final <- readline(prompt="What grade did you get on your final? ")
  final <- as.numeric(final)
  midterm <- readline(prompt="What grade did you get on your midterm? ")
  midterm <- as.numeric(midterm)
  homework <- readline(prompt="What overall grade did you got across your homework? ")
  homework <- as.numeric(homework)
  
  print(final*.50 + midterm*.30 + homework*.20)
}

overall_grade()
```
